sentences.text: Case :- Criminal Misc. Writ Petition No. - 7759 of 2024

Petitioner :- Sanawwar @ Palla
Respondent :- State Of U.P. And 4 Others

Counsel for Petitioner :- Arbaz Danish Counsel for Respondent :- G.A.
Hon'ble Vivek Kumar Birla,J.
Hon'ble Arun Kumar Singh Deshwal,J.
1. Heard Sri Arbaz Danish, learned counsel for the petitioner and Sri Ratan Singh, learned A.G.A.
appearing for the State respondents.
2. Personal affidavit filed today is taken on record.

3. Present petition has been filed with the following prayer:-
Sanawwar @ Palla vs State Of U.P. And 4 Others on 13 September, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/83905308/
1

entities.text: Sanawwar @ Palla vs State Of U.P. And 4 Others
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text:
"I. issue a writ order or direction in the nature of mandamus directing the respondent Authorites to release the petitioner on premature release in conviction and sentence dated 28.01.1982 in Session Trial No. 259/1980 (State vs. Sanawar @ Palla) arising out of Case Crime No. 198 of 1980 under Section 302, 34, 376/366 I.P.C. Police Station-Loni, District Ghaziabad, passed by the court of learned VI Additional District and Sessions Judge, Ghaziabad from Central Jail, Agra."
4. On 7.8.2024 following order was passed:-
"In para 14 of the counter affidavit filed on behalf of the State, it has been stated that Form -A/ proposal of the petitioner is pending at the level of District Magistrate,
Meerut.

District Magistrate, Meerut is directed to file his personal affidavit within three weeks explaining as to why he is detaining Form-A/proposal of the petitioner required to be sent to the State Government.

List this appeal on 13th September, 2024 as fresh case before appropriate court."
5.
In pursuance of the aforesaid order learned A.G.A. has produced instructions showing that the issue of premature release of the petitioner has been pending before the State Government.
6. In view of the above, the Principal Secretary (Prison Administration & Reform Services) is directed to consider the issue of premature release of the petitioner.

7. It is made clear that in case the Principal Secretary (Prison Administration & Reform Services)
finds that the issue is to be decided by some other authority, the same shall forthwith be forwarded before the authority concerned to be considered and decided within the aforesaid period.
8.
With the aforesaid observations, present petition stands disposed of.

Order Date :- 13.9.2024 Lalit Shukla  Sanawwar @ Palla vs State Of U.P. And 4 Others on 13 September, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/83905308/
